settings.heading: Ingredients
settings.content:
Herbans is powered by a focused blend of pumpkin seed oil and saw palmetto.

Pumpkin seed oil is naturally rich in fatty acids and plant nutrients that help support overall wellness, hair health, and urinary comfort.

Saw palmetto is a well-known botanical traditionally used to support men’s wellness, prostate comfort, and healthy DHT balance.

Together, these ingredients create a simple daily formula made to support fuller-looking hair, bladder comfort, and hormonal balance from within.

Herbans contains no complicated blends, no unnecessary extras, and no messy topical routine.

settings.heading: Directions
settings.content:
Take Herbans 2 softgels once a day.

For best results, use consistently and make it part of your routine. Most people take it with food or at the same time each day.

Results vary, but consistency matters.

settings.heading: Benefits
settings.content:
Herbans helps support healthier-looking hair, reduced visible shedding, urinary comfort, and overall daily wellness.

It’s designed for people who want a simple inside-out routine instead of relying only on shampoos, oils, or messy topical products.

With consistent use, Herbans helps support stronger-looking hair, a more comfortable daily routine, and confidence from within.

settings.heading: Guarantee
settings.content:
We want you to feel confident trying Herbans.

That’s why Herbans is backed by a 30-day guarantee. Use it consistently and give your body time to respond.

If it’s not for you, you’re covered by our return policy.
